message: You know, there’s a certain comedy in realizing you’re not quite ready for anything life throws your way. I once found myself scrambling for flashlights during a power outage, only to discover the batteries were long dead! 😂 But it's moments like these that remind me how important it is to be prepared, especially for the little ones. I recently came across a wonderful resource that makes getting kids involved in preparedness fun and engaging. It’s never too early to start teaching them about safety—after all, a little planning goes a long way! What’s your favorite way to stay prepared?
